requirements.statement: Support staff contact and resolution of non-collection, invalid contact, delay, shortage, and payment incidents without automatically blocking a customer.
Do not open online ordering until Jaime or a currently authorised delegate assumes and records responsibility for the service.
Reserve staff-access authorisation, revocation, and permission changes to Jaime.
Limit temporary staff and shared kitchen sessions to operational access without sensitive administration.
Record the responsible person at opening, handovers, shared-session use, and shift close without falsely claiming individual attribution.
Before disclosing order information in telephone support, require confirmation of customer name or order identifier in addition to telephone lookup.
Restrict weekly reports and export of order, telephone, commercial, or operational data to Jaime or explicitly authorised people.
Before collecting name and telephone number, explain that the data are used to manage the order and communicate operational changes or incidents.
Do not treat operational contact data as a customer account, commercial profile, loyalty enrolment, or marketing consent.
Keep telephone numbers hidden in routine kitchen queues and reveal them only through an explicit operational contact action.
Route personal-data access, correction, or deletion requests to Jaime rather than kitchen staff during active service.
Apply retention and anonymisation rules approved through the pre-launch compliance review to identified orders, telephone numbers, incidents, payment records, audit events, and SMS records.
Before pilot activation, record two complete weeks of order volume by channel and order-related call activity using the validated observation procedure.
Run the first real pilot segment under manual review with a limited informed participant group during a lower-pressure Wednesday or Thursday session.
Before the first real pilot order, pass a rehearsal covering all order channels, alerts, delays, stock conflicts, connectivity loss, payment, handover, and shift close.
Do not begin the pilot until the participating catalog, allergens, hours, stock, alerts, conservative thresholds, minimum privacy controls, and responsible presence are validated.

Pause the affected pilot scope for a missing or materially late accepted order, repeatedly unattended alerts, or incorrect allergen information; recurrence after a supposed fix shall trigger manual review or continued pause.
Exclude simulated and internal-test orders from real pilot calculations or report them in a separately labelled test-data segment.
Evaluate the pilot after four complete weeks using reliability, adoption, operational value, on-time performance, commercial observation, and controlled-progression evidence.
Ensure no accepted order is lost or reaches the kitchen materially too late for reasonable fulfilment under validated operating conditions.

Provide Jaime with a weekly pilot report covering channel volume, peak periods, incidents, delays, on-time performance, channel-specific average order value, best-selling products, and frequent combinations.
